page.overview:
Who is Calleen?

Calleen was a convor owned by the Jedi Master Lene Kostana, replacing her previous convor, Ferana. Kostana named the convor after Calleen, the Altiri goddess of wisdom. Jedi Master Dooku later used Calleen to follow the corrupt Coruscant Security Force inspector Sartori to the lair of the crime lord Cenevax. When Cenevax captured Dooku and his Padawan Qui-Gon Jinn, Calleen attacked the crime lord, but Cenevax killed the convor.

Calleen appeared in the audiobook Dooku: Jedi Lost, written by Cavan Scott and published in 2019.
